# Partiful — account brief

## Who
Partiful describes itself as "Delightful, free party invites. Plan events and parties with friends." ([source](https://partiful.com/)). Its GitHub org profile lists partiful.com ([source](https://github.com/partiful)).

## Production Expo signals
- eas.json in partiful/mobile ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/blob/main/eas.json))
- eas.json in partiful-app/mobile-legacy, a second org profile that also lists partiful.com ([source](https://github.com/partiful-app/mobile-legacy/blob/main/eas.json))
- react-native 0.74.5 in partiful/mobile/package.json ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/blob/main/package.json))
- CI workflows in partiful/mobile ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/tree/main/.github/workflows))
- 12 public repos and 180 followers on the org ([source](https://github.com/partiful))
- 41,200 App Store ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/partiful/id1590736570))
- 6 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/partiful/id1590736570))
- Open issue in partiful/mobile: "eas update rollout stuck at 0% for Android channel" ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/issues/61))
- A careers page is linked from the homepage ([source](https://partiful.com/careers)). The evidence does not say what roles are listed on it.

## Who to talk to
- Maintainer One (@partiful-maintainer-1), 142 commits, top contributor to partiful/mobile ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-1)). Profile lists company "Partiful" and website https://partiful.com ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-1)). No title or location in the evidence.
- Maintainer Two (@partiful-maintainer-2), 87 commits to partiful/mobile ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-2)). Profile lists company "Partiful" and website https://partiful.com ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-2)). No title or location in the evidence.
- Maintainer Three (@partiful-maintainer-3), 31 commits to partiful/mobile ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-3)). Profile lists company "Partiful" and website https://partiful.com ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-3)). No title or location in the evidence.

## Why now
partiful/mobile last pushed 2026-08-14 ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile)), and the app shipped 6 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/partiful/id1590736570)). The repo is on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/blob/main/package.json)) and carries an open issue about an EAS Update rollout stuck at 0% on an Android channel ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/issues/61)).

## Suggested opener
You have 142 commits in partiful/mobile ([source](https://github.com/partiful-maintainer-1)), which builds through EAS on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/blob/main/package.json)). There's an open issue in that repo about an eas update rollout stuck at 0% for an Android channel ([source](https://github.com/partiful/mobile/issues/61)), and the App Store shows 6 releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/partiful/id1590736570)). When that rollout stalled, did you hold the fix for the next store release or cut a new channel to get past it?
